content.text: Fetch all detail pages via eval.

input.command: orca eval --expression "(async()=>{const out=[];for(const a of document.querySelectorAll('main a')){const r=await fetch(a.href);const t=await r.text();const d=new DOMParser().parseFromString(t,'text/html');out.push(a.textContent+' | '+a.href+' | '+(d.querySelector('main')||d.body).innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' '))}return out.join('\n')})()" --json
